BiblicalUsage: The writer would make known the certainty of the words of truth, that a man might answer the words of truth to them that send him. And the psalmist says God has given a banner to them that fear him, that it may be displayed because of the truth. The word is equity, reality itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe truth is not an opinion but a weight, and the banner is given to those who fear God because the truth is.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
